verdict.rationale: First-party docs and the README describe multi-agent orchestration directly. Any app with more than one agent or node is a workflow, and the graph-based Workflow Runtime supports routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, nested workflows and human-in-the-loop. The Task API adds structured agent-to-agent delegation with multi-turn task mode and task agents usable as workflow nodes, which covers handoffs and subagents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and a concrete multi-agent code example (the only sample shown is a single agent).
